limitations: Bundled documentation establishes the documented algorithm, not measured implementation equivalence.
Pixel rounding and behavior for equal/reversed thresholds remain unverified against the original runtime.

findings.claim: The bundled documentation specifies a linear map from [minValue,maxValue] to [0,255], clipping below/above the interval to 0/255.
Input is restricted to 16-bit unsigned single-channel grayscale (Format_Gray16U).
Input/output IM registers are documented as 0..31; Threshold.min/max as 0..65535.
